output.one_liner: Create and publish posts, retrieve media and profiles, moderate replies, and access insights on Threads.

auth.notes: Threads user access tokens conforming to OAuth 2.0 protocol; short-lived (1 hour) or long-lived (60 days) tokens exchanged via authorization codes.

evidence.snippet: API authentication is handled by Threads user access tokens that conform to the OAuth 2.0 protocol.

access.notes: Self-serve: create app, test with Threads tester role at no cost. Production use with real users and multi-customer access requires App Review approval and app publication.

evidence.snippet: To access the Threads API, create an app and pick the Threads use case.
Threads testers can grant your app these permissions at any time.
each permission must first be approved through the App Review process, and your app must be published.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: 250 API-published posts per rolling 24-hour period; separate rate limits for replies, deletions, and location searches; query endpoint to check usage.

evidence.snippet: Publishing, Media retrieval, Reply management, User, Locations, Location search, Insights, oEmbed, Debug
Webhooks for Threads allow you to receive real-time notifications for the subscribed topics and fields.
Threads profiles are limited to 250 API-published posts within a rolling 24-hour period.

buildability.rationale: Documented REST API with self-serve testing via Threads tester sandbox, but production use requires App Review approval.
